record.reason: PoEM evaluates LLM capability without reliable labels by alternating model/human reference calibration and filtering. Experiments across 3 task types and 16 LLMs report 0.98 average Pearson correlation with supervised evaluation. The contribution is an evaluation method, not inference optimization; the linked test-time scaling paper is only a shared evaluation context.
record.title: Poor-Supervised Evaluation for SuperLLM via Mutual Consistency
